name: 43-google-tool-args-tryparse
description: The args coercion at :554 is `tryParse(arguments) ?? arguments`, and `tryParse` is JSON.parse with `undefined` on failure (util.js:571-577). The fallback is *nullish*, not falsy, and that is the whole point of this fixture: 'null' parses to JSON null and therefore falls back to the raw string 'null', while 'false' parses to boolean false and is kept as false (a `|| args` port would replace it), '5' stays the number 5, and 'not-json{' stays the raw string. Expected functionCall args, in order: {'city':'Tokyo'}, 'null', False, 5, 'not-json{'. The one tool turn resolves 'call_num' through toolNameMap, so its functionResponse name is 'get_int' and not 'unknown'.
